content:
## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Developer approved SPEC-20260716-233400 rev 2 after a high-level walkthrough and said 'Approve — start /build_module'. Build the green-able gate + stack profiles + ergonomics riders in scripts/quality_gate.py.
- **Files/scope**: SPEC-20260716-233400-greenable-gate-stack-profiles (docs/sprints/). Main change: scripts/quality_gate.py; new config/gate_profiles.yaml; tests/test_quality_gate.py; testing-playbook skill section; CLAUDE.md one-liner; doc sync where log schema documented.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: Make a RED gate mean exactly one thing (new debt) and fit the gate to the stack; precondition for reward-hacking canaries (triage #5). Evidence base: 2026-07-14 4-repo performance review (VP 85.5% red, AJ ruff-on-Dart, wiki fork).
- **Explicit constraints**: Rev 2 is authoritative (6 blocking findings folded). Golden fixture MUST be captured from pre-change main before build. This repo stays 7/7 green zero-config. Gate-log JSONL additive-only. Baseline human-gated (--rebaseline never run autonomously). Single _run() mock seam. Scope-fenced OUT: dart/markdown baselining, ledger Known-Broken parser fix (optional), file split unless >1200-1500 lines.

Build plan: 7 tasks from SPEC-20260716-233400 rev 2. T0 golden fixture from pre-change main (AC6, qa2). T1 profile infrastructure in quality_gate.py (yaml config load, precedence flag>config>autodetect, fail-closed, argv0 allow-list, unconditional integrity checks, markdown+.py warning). T2 debt baseline (ruff JSON fingerprints, set-membership compare incl swap-fail, shrink ratchet, --rebaseline human-gated, corrupt fails closed, check_review_existence extended to both gate config files). T3 ergonomics riders (one-line ERROR/WARN convention, additive JSONL fields profile/baseline_debt_count/rebaseline/fast, --fast deterministic sampling never refreshing pre-commit cache). T4 config/gate_profiles.yaml with python-fastapi/flutter-dart/markdown-corpus. T5 tests AC1-AC10 incl golden-fixture backward-compat + schema-pin. T6 docs (testing-playbook R3.5, CLAUDE.md gate line, syncing-framework-docs check).

Task 0 complete: golden fixture tests/fixtures/gate_summary_golden.txt captured from pre-change state (quality_gate.py verified byte-identical to main via git diff). Live gate run: 7/7 passed, exit 0. Fixture holds raw stdout incl ANSI + CRLF; the AC6 backward-compat test will normalize (strip ANSI/CR, mask variable counts, exclude advisory WARN lines) on both sides. Checkpoint bypass: scaffolding/fixture capture, no code generated.

Tasks 1-3 implemented in scripts/quality_gate.py (single file, ~1400 lines total) + Task 4 config/gate_profiles.yaml. Profiles: yaml.safe_load w/ schema_version validation, fail-closed GateConfigError -> single ERROR profile: line + exit 1; precedence flag>config-pin>autodetect (notice to stderr so stdout stays golden-identical); integrity checks structurally unconfigurable (non-stack keys warned+ignored); argv0 basename allow-list at check time; profile commands via _run() list-argv seam, output truncated last-20. Baseline: (check,posix-path,code) fingerprints from ruff JSON / Would-reformat lines; set-membership compare (swap fails); single collection in main shared by compare+ratchet+rebaseline; corrupt baseline fails closed; shrink-only ratchet; --rebaseline human-gated w/ consent notice + rebaseline:true log; unsupported-profile WARN (R1.0); gate config files added to review-existence paths (F1). Ergonomics: _fail(error_key=) emits exactly-one ERROR check: reason stderr line; WARN convention incl advisories; JSONL additive fields profile/baseline_debt_count/rebaseline/fast + disabled status; --fast stride-4 deterministic sample, forces coverage skip -> honest pass_with_skips, never touches commit-verified cache. Smoke-tested live: zero-config stdout identical shape 7/7-equivalent, markdown-corpus 3/3 pass w/ disabled statuses, --fast logs fast:true, unknown profile fails closed.

REVISE (0.8). HIGH: F3 allow-list bypass via path trick - _command_allowed checks only Path(argv0).name, but _run executes argv0 verbatim; 'C:/attacker/python.exe' passes as basename 'python' yet runs an attacker binary. Fix: reject argv0 containing any path separator or drive colon (bare PATH-resolved names only). LOW: F5 satisfied only by omission (gate never writes commit-verified; agent could still mark verified after --fast) - add a guard comment so a future auto-write change does not reintroduce. LOW: pre-existing git-unavailable fail-open in _get_staged_code_files now also covers the two reward-function config files (blast radius widened, not new). F1/F2/F4/F6 + baseline fail-closed judged soundly implemented.

REVISE (0.8). MEDIUM: check_tests with fast_files=[] (zero test files) passes no paths to pytest -> full-suite discovery, silently defeating the AC8 sample contract; treat empty as nothing-to-run. MEDIUM: profile entry command: [] passes validation (vacuous all()) but is falsy at dispatch -> silently falls through to built-in python check instead of fail-closed path; reject empty command at load time. LOW: _autodetect_profile lacks injectable root param (inconsistent with _load_* path= seams). LOW: directory-validation bail emits no ERROR line (AC7 convention inconsistency). Design otherwise sound: swap-case set-membership, fail-closed loaders, stderr-only notices preserving golden compat.

ROUND 2 APPROVE (0.9). HIGH F3 bypass properly closed: _command_allowed rejects any argv0 containing / \ or : before the allow-list lookup; suffix-stripping operates only on the validated bare name; all four stack-check sites route through check_profile_command (the only gate to _run for profile data); --fast _run call is hardcoded, no parallel route; empty commands rejected at load. No new bypass.

ROUND 2 APPROVE (0.85). Both MEDIUMs closed: check_tests(fast_files=[]) warns + returns True, never falls back to discovery; _validate_profile_entry raises on empty command at load, no validate/dispatch gap; injectable root params correct; setup ERROR line added. Non-blocking note: AC-coverage tests still to land this build round (in-plan).

What I missed: caught the two functional edge cases but did not push on test isolation for the fix verification - did not confirm Round 2 regression tests exercise both edge cases with deterministic fixtures rather than live-repo file counts. Candidate rule: for fail-closed-on-empty-input fixes, require the regression test to assert on an explicitly empty/mocked input set, not an incidentally-empty one. Calibration delta: -0.05. (Builder note: shipped test passes fast_files=[] explicitly - concern already satisfied.)

What I missed: approved the Round-2 fix partly on facilitator description rather than independently grepping all call sites first; under-scoped the LOW on fail-open _get_staged_code_files (it now gates review-existence for the two reward-function config files, so a git-unavailable fail-open weakens a load-bearing control, not just pre-existing behavior); never stated the residual trust boundary that the allow-list still trusts PATH-resolved bare names. Candidate rule: for any finding involving a shared execution/allow-list chokepoint, require call-site enumeration in the Round 1 finding, not deferred to fix-verification. Calibration delta: -0.05.

Build complete: 7 tasks (T0 golden fixture from pre-change state; T1-T3 profiles/baseline/ergonomics in scripts/quality_gate.py, now 1591 lines; T4 config/gate_profiles.yaml; T5 46 new tests, suite 131 passing in test_quality_gate.py; T6 docs CAPTURE_PIPELINE + FRAMEWORK_SPECIFICATION + CLAUDE.md + testing-playbook). 1 consolidated checkpoint fired (security + qa, both REVISE round 1 -> 6 findings fixed incl HIGH argv0 path-trick allow-list bypass + 2 MEDIUM edge cases -> both APPROVE round 2 at 0.9/0.85), 0 unresolved concerns. Live gate 7/7 green zero-config (AC6 dogfooding), ruff clean, full suite + coverage pass. OPEN ITEM for /review: file is 1591 lines, marginally over the spec 1200-1500 split fence - split deferred (would churn diff + break test monkeypatch seams); reviewer/developer to decide. Reflections: both specialists delta -0.05.
